scope: Local fleet attempt with explicit step duration; retain every failed gate. New protocol totals require closed continuous per-scenario evidence. Optional final raw snapshots can miss sparse series; absence is null rather than an invented zero. Historical reports are unchanged. No production capacity certification.

profile.scope: local independent app/PG clusters with verified local Caddy, no public DNS/controller

ingress.kind: real Caddy with verified internal CA on loopback
ingress.reload_fault: valid configuration rejected by an occupied owned backend listener; restore and probe without process replacement

webhooks.receiver: owned loopback, verified signatures and durable event identities

profile.resource_protocol: component cgroup v2 via shell builtins and bounded parallel owned probes; allocated du totals count only disappearing child entries

capacity.scope: Short functional profile without capacity qualification
